title: El Hadji Bassirou Touré
text:
El Hadji Bassirou Touré is an Associate Professor in the Department of Mathematics and Computer Science at the Faculty of Science and Technology, Université Cheikh Anta Diop de Dakar. He teaches Software Engineering and Artificial Intelligence at bachelor’s and master’s level, at the FST and at the École Supérieure Polytechnique, and coordinates the third-year bachelor’s programme in Bioinformatics and Biomathematics.
He received his PhD from UCAD in 2020, with a thesis on the maintenance of large-scale systems based on megamodels. His research lies at the intersection of Model-Driven Engineering, Software Engineering and AI applied to education. He leads the IA4Nieup adaptive learning platform and drives curriculum development for DiCentre4AI.
Committed to building AI capacity in Africa, he trains faculty members within the DAP/AFRETEC programmes and takes part in cohort 6 of the African Futures Research Leadership Program (Michigan State University).

title: Research
text: This research examines what is lost, or added, when one software artifact is transformed into another. This includes turning one model into another (model transformations) and a monolithic application into microservices (consistency management). More broadly, it addresses complex systems maintained through megamodeling. In parallel, a second line of research focuses on AI for education: teacher-centered adaptive learning for large classes in Africa.

title: Research
text:
Active projects

SEMANTICA — Model Transformations and AI
Decomposing semantic loss in model transformations using neural embeddings; queryable megamodels and Bayesian integration of new domain-specific modeling languages (DSMLs).
Related publication: Decomposing Semantic Loss in Model Transformations with Neural Embeddings (ICECET 2026).


AI4Nieup — Adaptive Learning Platform for AI Education
Democratizing AI education in Africa: personalized learning paths by level (intuition / application / formal), data grounded in African contexts, and integrated hands-on labs. Developed within DiCentre4AI and the African Futures Research Leadership Program (AFRLP) of the Alliance for African Partnership (AAP), Michigan State University (MSU).


Consistency in Microservice Architectures
Extending the Micro-Flex framework (ICTIS 2025): a complete transition function, a TLA+ specification verified by model checking, and a DSL for consistency contracts.
Related publication: Micro-Flex: Flexible Consistency Management in Microservice Architectures Through Megamodel-Based State Transition Rules (ICTIS 2025).


Personalized Educational Pathways in STEM
Adaptive systems for teaching mathematics, with the goal of increasing the number of students choosing science tracks in Senegal.
